title: Silent Alarm
description: Detecting a conflict in the API is only half the job — FR-903 requires the scheduling board to surface it as a visible banner or toast, not bury it in the browser console. Create a double-booking through the UI and confirm the warning is actually visible.
successCondition: After dragging two shipments onto overlapping slots for the same driver or vehicle on the Fleet & Scheduling board, a visible on-page element (not just a console.error) announces the conflict — e.g. a banner with role="alert" or role="status" naming the affected driver/vehicle.
hints: Log in as a dispatcher or admin — the fleet board is dispatch-only.
Don't just check that GET /api/fleet/conflicts returns data — verify the DOM actually renders something a user would see, per the project's rule that flaky/conflict states must never be console-only.
